findings.claim: The document status table is materialized but never made publishable/readable by the replication boundary, so processing status is not actually published to the browser replica.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.3 requires "Register document status lane/privacy/columns/tenant/revocation and extend projection/materialization" and the proposal requires "publish processing status"; this migration creates `aso.document_statuses`, enables RLS, and `REVOKE ALL ON aso.document_statuses FROM PUBLIC`, but contains no `ALTER PUBLICATION ... ADD TABLE`, no SELECT grant to a replication/shape role, and no read policy for the status projection.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the document status relation to the approved explicit-table publication path and grant/policy the exact replication role needed for the approved columns and practice predicate, or call the repository's existing publication registration mechanism in this migration.

findings.claim: The fresh local schema creates `cases` without the columns that the current case projection sync requests, causing the current browser replica to reject or drop case rows on a fresh client.
findings.evidence: `web/src/shared/sync/electric-shapes.ts` requests case columns `case_number`, `patient_id`, `surgeon_id`, `coordinator_id`, `payer_id`, `date_of_service`, and `revision`, but `PGLITE_SCHEMA_SQL` in `web/src/shared/sync/pglite-schema.ts` creates `cases` with only `id`, `practice_id`, `status`, `gate_affirmed_at`, `created_at`, and `updated_at`; those requested columns are only added later in `PGLITE_CASE_SUMMARY_SQL`, which is labeled an additive migration rather than the base fresh schema.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the base current schema used for fresh PGlite initialization to create `cases` with the same columns as `SYNC_COLUMNS`, or ensure the local migration runner always applies `PGLITE_CASE_SUMMARY_SQL` before any shape materialization on a fresh store.

findings.claim: The change leaves its own verification and completion tasks unchecked even though the acceptance packet requires them to be recorded and marked when satisfied.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria include 2.1 "Run focused T0/T1 plus forbidden-source-column sabotage-and-restore, artifact-refiner, and adversarial review" and 3.1 "Record actual commands and observed outputs ... and mark only satisfied work complete"; `tasks.md` still has `- [ ] 2.1` and `- [ ] 3.1` while the evidence summary claims those checks were run.
findings.suggested_fix: Update `tasks.md` to mark completed verification/completion items consistently with retained evidence, or remove the claimed completion evidence if those tasks are not actually complete.
